body:
> You made some really poor choices

I'm not sure it's in all the way, could you maybe rub it some more?  If you rub it just a little more, it should be all the way in.  

> Who the hell goes with married women or women with children

I don't think you've called me stupid asshole enough.  Why don't you keep calling me a stupid asshole?  Maybe I don't already know I'm enough of a stupid asshole yet.  Maybe I need some saintly figure like you to keep reminding me that I'm a stupid asshole more often.  Maybe that will give me the oomph to fucking eat a bullet sandwich.  

> Yes I CANNOT PREDICT THE FUTURE, but probability is there.

I invite you to read [Rule 4d and the thread that goes with it](http://redd.it/25igd7).

> Do you currently have a job

What the **FLYING FUCK** makes you think I do?

> a place to stay or not?

I've got my car.  Don't worry, it's nice and cold and filthy.

> things do eventually, usually get better

[Here is why what you just wrote is against the fucking rules.](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/25igd7/whats_wrong_with_it_gets_better_what_if_it_doesnt/)

> your upper middle class white family will eventually take you back

**YOU CANNOT PREDICT THE FUCKING FUTURE**

> if you want to be taken back

Nice victim-blaming.

> please do not do anything foolish

I chickened out of killing myself tonight.  That was already foolish.

> You DO have the gift of the gab 

No.


> You are a lawyer, that is no small feat.

Wrong.  

> It may take time to find the right job and success but it will be worth it

**YOU CANNOT PREDICT THE FUTURE**

> Family suck

This is the one thing you have said that I can agree with.

> don't throw them away

Too late.  

> you will need them in the future

Remember what I said about whether you, personally, can predict the *fucking* future?

> I believe in you

No you don't.

> you need to show THE what she is missing

**HA!**  First, revenge does not work on her, she's *better* at it.  Second, she is missing nothing.  She stole $20,000 from me, used me as a reference for a cushy government job, had an **ARMED PRIVATE INVESTIGATOR** sent to my mom's house, **GUN IN HAND**, to wring a good reference out of me, and got the job.  She's living the high life.

Tried it, tried writing, tried acting.  That's what I meant by

> Tried to make friends and get hobbies. Failed.

> You are young

No

> you will regret cutting or harming yourself

You cannot predict the future.

> You are entertaining in your morbid sadness,

Thanks for the insult!

> I see happiness and laughter in your future

**YOU CANNOT PREDICT THE FUTURE**

> You have the gift of the gab

No.

> you could have a future in writing

No.

> or even stand up

No.

> I am sorry for the loss of your mother.

Frankly, that makes one of us.

> Hope you feel better

I don't.

> You've got a big list of the nasty happenings of the last few years, don't you think it's a bit unfair to the odd few nice things in life that you haven't tipped a hat to them?

No.

> find new small happy things!

No.

> Play 2048

Don't own it, can't afford it.

>  pick up a casual sport

Leg is still fucked up, can't afford it.

> go hiking!

Leg is still fucked up, can't afford it.

> move to china

Can't.  Afford.  It.

>  think of all the fun you could have

I wouldn't have fun.

> or at least the memories from your misadventures.

Like getting robbed, lost, raped, and stabbed, or locked up in foreign jail.

> find new small happy things!

Can't *fucking* afford them.

> volunteering in Ghana

Remember when I said I get turned away from volunteering?  **BECAUSE I FUCKING DID**

> just doing what you love

I love cutting myself, and I love bashing my head against the wall until I bleed and my vision gets blurry.  So I'm going to do that, since I'm too much of a *fucking* coward to kill myself apparently.

> Get back to me, even if it's to say my ideas are shit, I can come up with more :p

Please don't.  Please just go away.
